decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT at 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Subject custody holds: sha256 bcc76ee3… as expected, mode 0444, 21235 bytes, unmoved at start and end, unedited. All 37 path/digest citations across 18 distinct paths resolve byte-exactly against live bytes, and the top-level head, recordedInputs.HEAD and git HEAD are all ebb7889. required-now is independently derived as 28 from live file 08 (32 DR-G* rows minus G05 deferred, G17 dropped/not-required-now, G26 inapplicable, G30 deferred) and is unchanged. D-274 is confirmed the last live heading and its basedOn role is last-heading custody only, with d216/d176/d263 each disclaiming last-heading status and all four commits resolving to their claimed recordings. leftoverDesign is preserved exactly as [OBL-G18-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-ENCODING-RESERVED]: the obligation id set is identical to v3 with zero additions, zero drops and zero leftoverDesign flips, and the v3-to-v4 delta is confined to the intended v2-to-occupancy-v4 restatement — indeed v3's leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded sentence is removed, not strengthened. Nothing is SATISFIED or QUALIFIED, Class A is not opened, the identifier is not occupied, no journal, fixture byte, D9 code, section 7.1 recipe, lock-file grammar, lease API, solver or filesystem layout is invented, file 08 and COORD are untouched, and docs/v2/implementation/ is not authorized.
